Roadmap

This page outlines Momento's planned improvements for the coming weeks and months. It is a living document that will be updated as the project evolves.

  • Dark mode enhancements – refine contrast, improve focus states, and add a theme switcher to the navigation bar.
  • Accessibility improvements – add ARIA labels where missing, improve keyboard navigation, and ensure full keyboard operability for all interactive elements.
  • Search feature – implement a lightweight search that indexes site pages and provides instant results.
  • Contributor guidelines – publish a CONTRIBUTING.md with clear contribution workflow, code style, and testing instructions.
  • Performance optimizations – minify CSS/JS, enable compression, and add a lightweight preloading strategy for critical resources.
  • Community features – add a simple discussion board or comment system for user feedback.

Each item will be tracked in the Changes page as work progresses. Contributions are welcome; see Contribute for details.
